recipe:
set -e
d=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/published/catalog_processing/pure_eb_sweep.tar.gz -C $d
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/published/covariances/pure_eb_covariance_sweep.tar.gz -C $c
o=$(mktemp -d)
b="$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py fiducial_blind blind_a)"
versions=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --nonfiducial)
for ver in $versions; do
  python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/calculate_pure_eb_ptes.py \
    --version "$ver" --blind "$b" \
    --pure-eb-data "$d/$ver"_pure_eb_data.npz \
    --pure-eb-covariance "$c/$ver"_"$b"_pure_eb_covariance.npz \
    --npatch 1 --out "$o"
done
tar czf results/published/significance/pure_eb_ptes.tar.gz -C $o .
